days.state: Rested, coffee, three sessions running, one waiting.
Deep in one repo for two hours; a permission prompt is waiting in another session.
Just out of a hard meeting; four sessions moved while she was away.
Slept badly, dreading a PR review, capacity at thirty percent.

goals.text: Open the app and know what needs her, if anything.
Allow or deny a waiting permission prompt with enough context to decide.
Answer a question Claude asked, by option or in her own words.
Read what a session concluded without reading its history.
Start a new session in a folder she names, without a mouse.
Put a session down with a note so she can come back tomorrow.
Find a session from last week and pick it up.
End a stale session without feeling judged.
